subject: Add log about old primary after myself failover (#1058)
reason: The change only adds a serverLog(LL_NOTICE) line in clusterFailoverReplaceYourPrimary() recording the old primary when a replica promotes itself. It changes no command reply, state transition, replication, or persistence behavior. The logged values are safe: the function returns early when old_primary is NULL, and human_nodename is always an sds initialized to sdsempty(), the same idiom used by many existing log lines in cluster_legacy.c. A log-only change has no observable behavior for the fuzzer's oracles or a compared command sequence to detect, so no scenario is needed.
